lead.event: Fortune Indonesia completes rights issue to acquire Borneo Prima stake
lead.headline: FORU completes Rp21.37 trillion rights issue to acquire Borneo Prima stake
lead.blurb: Fortune Indonesia completed the rights issue on 7 October, with 169.61 billion of 215.10 billion offered shares taken up at Rp126 each. Controlling shareholder IMR Asia Holding subscribed for 165.22 billion shares by contributing its 49% stake in Borneo Prima, valued at Rp20.81 trillion, leaving around Rp500 billion in cash proceeds. IMR Asia Holding remains Borneo Prima’s controller through Fortune Indonesia.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: GoTo carries out Rp3.5 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: GOTO prepares share buyback of up to Rp3.5 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Shareholders approved the program at GoTo’s June AGM, with the funds expected to absorb passive outflows estimated at 116 billion shares, or 10% of public circulation, after the Rp50 price floor was removed. CEO Hans Patuwo said it could add value if shares are undervalued, while JPMorgan previously estimated it could absorb all outflows if purchases are below Rp30 per share.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: IDX sets theoretical price for Bukit Uluwatu Villa rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: IDX sets theoretical price for BUVA rights issue covering 6.15 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The price was set at Rp522 and adjusted to Rp520 for regular and negotiation trading on 14 October. BUVA will offer the shares at Rp250 each in a 4:1 rights issue, targeting Rp1.53 trillion for working capital and debt repayment.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Hartadinata Abadi plans private placement to fund gold purchases
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: HRTA plans 460.53 million-share placement to fund gold purchases
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Hartadinata Abadi plans to issue up to 460.53 million shares, equal to 10% of its fully paid shares. Proceeds would fund working capital, mainly gold purchases from non-affiliated suppliers; the strategic investor and issue price have not been announced. Shareholder approval is scheduled for 16 October, with issuance potentially in stages over two years from then.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BTPN Syariah plans and secures approval for Rp1 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BTPS secures approval for buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: BTPN Syariah shareholders approved the program at an extraordinary meeting, allowing it to cover up to 10% of placed capital and be funded from company equity. Implementation starts 14 October.

earnings_guidance.event: Graha Layar Prima reports Q2 2026 net loss and lower revenue
earnings_guidance.headline: BLTZ reports Q2 net loss of Rp14.73 billion as revenue falls 16.68%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Graha Layar Prima's revenue fell to Rp512.40 billion from Rp614.76 billion a year earlier. Ticket revenue declined to Rp310.82 billion from Rp386.11 billion, while food-and-beverage sales fell to Rp161.40 billion from Rp193.93 billion. Operating profit dropped 55.16% to Rp38.47 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset raises Indosat price target to Rp3,850
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset raises ISAT price target to Rp3,850
earnings_guidance.blurb: Indosat invested US$200 million for a 37% stake in Zankore, which targets an initial 100 MW capacity in the first half of 2027. Mirae estimates Zankore and Infra Fiber Teknologi will contribute Rp1.2 trillion to Rp2.5 trillion in net profit during 2027–2028, while flagging project execution and slower-than-expected AI demand risks.

earnings_guidance.event: Ciptadana raises Erajaya Swasembada target price while maintaining Buy rating
earnings_guidance.headline: Ciptadana raises ERAA target price to Rp 850, maintains Buy rating
earnings_guidance.blurb: Ciptadana Sekuritas Asia sees 40.5% upside from a Rp 605 reference price for Erajaya, after the iPhone 18 Pro sold more than 320,000 units on its first day. It expects average phone selling prices to rise 27% in Q4-2026, up from its prior 20% estimate, and raised phone sales forecasts by 3% for 2026 and 9% for 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX expands high-shareholding-concentration methodology and updates stock list
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX expands concentration review and names 19 stocks on list
market_structure_policy.blurb: The exchange lowered the market-cap threshold for its price-impact-ratio review to Rp5 trillion from Rp10 trillion. MD Entertainment (FILM) and NexAI Digital Infrastruktur (MGLV) left the category, while analysts cited short-term selling pressure because listed stocks include constituents of MSCI and FTSE indexes, raising index-removal risk.

deals_control.event: Samudra Investment raises its Mitra Adiperkasa stake to 31.13%
deals_control.headline: Samudra Investment raises MAPI stake to 31.13% through share purchase
deals_control.blurb: In its 9 October purchase of Mitra Adiperkasa shares, Samudra Investment paid Rp1,523 per share, spending around Rp285.28 billion for investment purposes. Its holding had been 30%, while controller Pacific Universal Investment holds 51%.

deals_control.event: Victoria Care Indonesia controlling shareholder sells 402.48 million shares
deals_control.headline: VICI controller sells 402.48 million shares for Rp301.86 billion
deals_control.blurb: The negotiated-market sale by Sukses Sejati Sejahtera on 9 October was priced at Rp750 a share, about 40% below the prior regular-market close. Its stake fell from 84.95% to 78.95%, and Victoria Care Indonesia said it would retain control.
